The Hosting Announcement

Saturday Night Live has officially confirmed that actress Amanda Seyfried will lead the upcoming December 5 episode as host. The news was shared during the live broadcast of the November 14 installment, which was hosted by John Mulaney.

Accompanying Seyfried for the night will be Don Toliver, who is scheduled to perform as the musical guest. This upcoming appearance marks a first-time milestone for both prominent figures on the late-night program.

Season 52 Break and Schedule

Following the conclusion of John Mulaney's Season 52 episode, the sketch comedy staple is entering a three-week hiatus. Production will pause before the show returns to Studio 8H during the first week of December.

As the program moves toward the end of the year, the network has not yet announced the hosts or musical guests for the subsequent episodes scheduled for December 12 and December 19.

First-Time Hosts This Season

When Amanda Seyfried steps into the hosting role next month, she will achieve a notable distinction within the current broadcast run. Her appearance establishes her as the fourth first-time host of Season 52.

The previous debut hosts for this season include Jalen Brunson, Inde Navarrette, and Druski, all of whom stepped up to lead the show for the very first time in their careers.

Recent Success With You Can See Everything

The hosting announcement caps off a remarkably busy autumn period for the performer. She has generated substantial media attention over the past month due to her surprising involvement in a conversation-starting documentary.

Directed by Lance Oppenheim and Nathan Fielder, the project titled You Can See Everything has sparked major discussions. In the documentary, the actress reprises elements of her previous dramatic work by portraying Elizabeth Holmes during unrecorded reenactments.

On-Screen Confrontations

Within the framework of the documentary, the performer steps beyond simple reenactments to become a confrontational figure against the divisive partner of Holmes, Billy Evans.

A fierce argument between these two individuals serves as the focal point for one of the feature's most widely analyzed and discussed scenes.

Interviews and Silence Broken

The late-night program announcement arrived in the exact same week that the actress broke her silence regarding the documentary project. She engaged in a comprehensive, wide-ranging interview alongside both Fielder and Oppenheim.

This media appearance allowed the star to finally address her secretive involvement in the project, which had already managed to light up the box office following its October theatrical release.

Prior Parodies on the Show

The upcoming December episode will not be the first time Season 52 has touched upon the popular documentary. The cultural phenomenon was previously referenced during the November 7 installment hosted by Druski.

That particular episode featured a pre-taped sketch where the internet personality imagined a scenario where the documentary subjects approached him instead of the actual directors, complete with a memorable impersonation of Holmes.

The news follows a major career fall for the actress, highlighted by her role in the documentary You Can See Everything directed by Lance Oppenheim and Nathan Fielder.

ld.articleBody:
An Ambitious Campaign For The Academy

Sony Pictures has officially launched an aggressive Best Picture campaign targeting the 99th Academy Awards for Spider-Man: Brand New Day. The studio has brought on professional awards consultants to strengthen its Oscar push, with chairman and CEO Tom Rothman personally backing the initiative.

To ensure Academy voters experience the film properly, Sony is arranging special screenings starting just before Thanksgiving. Additionally, a theatrical re-release is planned before the end of the year specifically to capture the attention of voters who missed it on the big screen.

A Historic Box Office Success

The studio's push is heavily backed by the blockbuster's phenomenal commercial performance. According to Box Office Mojo, the movie has grossed approximately $2.5 billion worldwide.

Furthermore, the film reportedly shattered the all-time domestic opening record previously held by Avengers: Endgame, giving Sony strong commercial leverage for its awards narrative.

The Long History Of Oscar Struggles

Despite dominating global box offices for years, the superhero giant has faced a complicated relationship with the Academy regarding major categories. Recognition for the franchise has historically stayed restricted mostly to technical wins.

The live-action Spider-Man franchise serves as a prime example of this trend, having secured only a single win across eight films when Spider-Man 2 took home Best Visual Effects.

Technical Wins Versus Major Categories

Across the wider Marvel Cinematic Universe, the numbers reflect a similar pattern of limited major category representation. The franchise has gathered 19 total Oscar nominations, with ten of those coming from visual effects alone.

Recognition in premier categories such as Best Picture remains exceedingly rare for comic book adaptations. Only two superhero films in history, Black Panther and Joker, have managed to break into the Best Picture race.

Breaking The 22-Year Streak

The last major win for a live-action Spider-Man film occurred 22 years ago with the visual effects victory of Spider-Man 2. Sony aims to change this historical limitation permanently with Brand New Day.

With Tom Rothman driving the campaign and the impending release of Avengers: Doomsday, the studio sees a unique window to secure Marvel's biggest Oscar recognition to date.

ld.articleBody:
The Surprising Departure

The entertainment industry was recently shaken by the unexpected announcement that James Gunn is stepping down as co-CEO of DC Studios. This major leadership change comes just four years after he initially took the reins to build a cohesive shared cinematic universe for the studio.

With his exit, the future direction of the shared universe has been thrown into uncertainty, leaving followers and industry analysts questioning the fate of previously announced slates and interconnected projects.

Awkward Resurfaced Remarks

In the wake of the leadership shuffle, several past promotional interviews and red carpet soundbites given by actors have quickly resurfaced online. Observers have noted that many of these enthusiastic statements about the studio's direction feel quite different now.

Actors who previously expressed high praise for the creative vision under the outgoing administration are suddenly finding their recent comments under a much different lens following the sudden corporate shift.

Tom Rhys Harries and Clayface

Among the prominent examples is an interview featuring actor Tom Rhys Harries, who stars in the recent theatrical release Clayface. Speaking previously with Parade, the performer shared his excitement about joining the franchise.

Harries had noted that he was a fan prior to his involvement and expressed pride in being part of the expanding universe being shaped by the leadership team. Now, those glowing words highlight the unexpected nature of the recent regime change.

Uncertain Future for the Cast

The sudden shift leaves performers like Harries in a state of professional limbo regarding their characters' futures. It remains entirely unclear if he will get the opportunity to reprise his role or potentially face off against Batman in future installments.

Other members of the ensemble casts, such as Skyler Gisondo, have also started breaking their silence regarding the transition, acknowledging that nobody involved knows for sure what direction the studio will take next.

Leadership Succession

Following the departure of James Gunn and Peter Safran, who had initially mapped out an extensive roster of upcoming features and television projects, new leadership is stepping in. Jeremy Latcham is now tasked with steering the shared cinematic universe forward.

It remains to be seen how the incoming leadership will handle the existing framework left behind by the previous team and whether they will choose to honor or completely alter the previously announced slate of productions.

Box Office Pressures

Industry observers point out that the leadership change followed a challenging theatrical period for the brand. Recent box office struggles, including the performance of Supergirl and the reception of Clayface, reportedly influenced the decision to seek new guidance.

These commercial hurdles played a significant role in prompting the studio to pivot and bring in fresh leadership to reevaluate the strategy for the superhero franchise moving forward.

Upcoming Releases on the Horizon

Despite the executive shakeup, the rollout of completed projects must still move forward. The next major film slated to hit theaters is Man of Tomorrow, scheduled for release on July 9, 2027.

Because that particular feature was already shot and directed by Gunn himself, upcoming promotional tours and press events are expected to generate considerable media attention and awkward questions from reporters.

News Overview

James Gunn has stepped down as co-CEO of DC Studios just four years after starting his tenure, leading to uncertainty for the shared universe and leaving past red carpet comments from actors like Tom Rhys Harries looking remarkably out of place. With Jeremy Latcham taking over leadership following recent box office setbacks, the future of upcoming projects such as Man of Tomorrow remains in question.

ld.articleBody:
A Landmark Submission for Cyprus

The international cinematic landscape has witnessed a historic milestone as the feature debut titled Hold Onto Me became the official selection representing Cyprus for the Academy Awards. This achievement marks the very first time the nation has submitted a film for consideration in the international feature category. The journey for the project began with significant acclaim on the festival circuit, bringing unprecedented recognition to the Mediterranean island's growing film industry.

Navigating this path has positioned the creative team as pioneers in their home country. While acknowledging the status of being underdogs on the global stage, the production has embraced the opportunity to open doors for future creators from the region. The milestone highlights a growing presence for regional European co-productions in mainstream global competitions.

Plot Dynamics and Character Journeys

Set against the backdrop of a Cypriot summer, the narrative centers on an eleven-year-old girl named Iris whose routine is disrupted by the death of her grandfather. The event brings her estranged father, Aris, back into town—a man who operates as a petty criminal and has previously played no role in her life. Despite warnings from her mother and older brother, Iris pursues a connection, eventually joining him in various dubious schemes.

What begins as a stubborn quest for familial ties slowly evolves into a complicated bond between two practical strangers. The relationship is further strained when the father's dark past draws them both into escalating trouble. Throughout the script, every scene is carefully constructed to push the narrative forward while exploring the fragile boundaries of trust and acceptance.

Festival Success and Global Screenings

Before making waves in the Oscar race, the picture celebrated its world premiere at the prestigious Sundance Film Festival. There, it resonated deeply with audiences, ultimately capturing the World Cinema Dramatic Audience Award. This early momentum established a strong foundation for international distribution and critical praise.

Following its success in North America, the project continued its festival run by screening in the youth and children's event at the Tallinn Black Nights Film Festival in Estonia. Sales and international distribution for the title are managed by Cercamon, ensuring the feature reaches diverse audiences across multiple territories.

Personal Roots in the Director's Vision

The emotional core of the feature draws heavily from the lived experiences of its writer and director. Growing up with divorced parents, the filmmaker experienced a distant relationship with her father during her early childhood before they successfully bonded and forged a deep understanding during her teens. These autobiographical elements infused the script with authentic observations regarding familial expectations and delayed reconciliation.

Additionally, the physical locations mirror the creator's upbringing, utilizing coastal settings near the sea where she spent her youth. The presence of older companions and childhood memories heavily influenced the framing of the protagonist's daily life, grounding the dramatic fiction in specific personal truths.

Unconventional Casting and Chemistry

Bringing the central characters to life involved pairing an established screen actor with a complete novice. Christos Passalis, known for his work in Dogtooth, was cast as the delinquent father after the director decided to work with him months before production began. Finding the right counterpart involved testing the actor with various young performers before discovering Maria Petrova in Cyprus.

Despite having zero prior acting experience, the young newcomer shared a natural physical resemblance and an undeniable onscreen chemistry with her co-star. Due to scheduling conflicts and an unexpected bout of COVID-19, the leads had virtually no rehearsal time prior to filming, replicating the real-life unfamiliarity of their characters when cameras finally rolled.

A Creative Triptych and Future Ambitions

The exploration of father-daughter dynamics is not new to the director, who previously examined similar themes through two earlier short projects. Her 2015 short film Semele initiated this thematic journey, followed by a subsequent short titled Aria featuring an adolescent protagonist. The feature-length production served as a natural extension, allowing the creator to dive much deeper into the complex energy generated by familial obligations.

Looking ahead, the filmmaker plans to pivot away from father-daughter narratives while continuing to explore stories centered on strangers who gradually discover shared similarities. Current professional endeavors include developing a crime and spy thriller television series, alongside evaluating various scripts sent by U.S. agents with the possibility of directing material she did not write.

Written and directed by Myrsini Aristidou, the feature-length debut stars newcomer Maria Petrova and Christos Passalis as an estranged father and daughter navigating a fragile bond.

ld.articleBody:
Standing Firm on Script Choices

Commercial performance frequently dictates the trajectory of filmmakers and performers in the entertainment industry. However, Alia Bhatt has firmly stated that she will not allow box office results to control the types of narratives she decides to explore.

The actor intends to keep supporting and starring in women-led projects. This commitment remains unwavering even after the underwhelming theatrical runs experienced by movies like Jigra and Alpha.

Double Standards in the Film Industry

While speaking to TIME magazine following her inclusion in the TIME100 Next India list, Bhatt highlighted the distinct expectations placed on female actors. She pointed out the double standards that apply differently to films driven by men versus women.

She publicly questioned why a commercial failure from a male-led project rarely initiates broader conversations about whether audiences are fatigued by male-centric storytelling.

Embracing the Risk of Female-Centric Stories

Bhatt has previously addressed the inherent financial risks involved in carrying projects centred on women, particularly within genres traditionally dominated by male protagonists. She noted that when male-driven features stumble, critics do not call for an end to male-centric cinema.

ld.articleBody:
Casting Expansion for Season Two

The Netflix psychological thriller project The Beast in Me has expanded its cast roster by welcoming a prominent Hunger Games franchise star. Lili Taylor has officially signed on to appear as a series regular in the upcoming episodes.

Her addition brings fresh talent to the ongoing narrative alongside returning lead performers. Netflix has kept specific plot details regarding the forthcoming narrative under wraps for now.

Parental Roles for New Cast Members

Reports indicate that Lili Taylor will star alongside fellow new addition John Goodman to portray parental figures in the series. They are set to play the mother and father figures connected to the main character.

Specifically, John Goodman has been cast to play the father, Jack, while Lili Taylor will step into the role of the stepmother, Fiona.

Return of the Protagonist and Creators

Claire Danes is confirmed to reprise her starring role as the grieving author Aggie Wiggs. Her character was central to the eerie events of the initial run.

Behind the scenes, Howard Gordon and Daniel Pearle are back steering the project as co-showrunners. They also carry executive producer responsibilities for the program.

Expanded Executive Producer Team

A large collective of executive producers supports the production alongside the showrunners. This group includes Claire Danes, Gabe Rotter, and Antonio Campos.

Additional executive producers feature Caroline Baron, Amy Lippman, Conan O’Brien, David Kissinger, Jeff Ross, and Jodie Foster.

Exploring Family Backgrounds

The introduction of Aggie Wiggs' parents strongly hints at a deeper dive into the protagonist's personal history. Observers expect the upcoming episodes to unpack familial secrets.

This narrative shift towards family background has heightened anticipation among viewers tracking the psychological drama.

Notable Acting Backgrounds

Lili Taylor brings extensive experience as a three-time Emmy nominee with notable credits in Outer Range and Daredevil: Born Again as Governor Marge McCaffrey. She is also slated to appear as Mags Flanagan in The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping.

Meanwhile, John Goodman enters the project following recent appearances in Digger and Chili Finger.

Origins and Past Plotline

The Beast in Me originally launched on the platform as a limited series before securing a renewal. Its first season centered on grieving author Aggie Wiggs and her obsession with a mysterious neighbor named Nile Jarvis, played by Matthew Rhys.

That initial entanglement drew her deep into a web of suspicion and dark secrets. At present, the streaming service has not shared a specific premiere date for the new season.

Introduction of Five Iconic Magical Figures

HBO has officially revealed five additional cast members for the upcoming Harry Potter television adaptation. This wave of casting focuses heavily on the enchanted residents and guardians scattered throughout the sprawling halls of Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry.

Among the newly confirmed talent are actors stepping into some of the most memorable supernatural and stationary roles from the inaugural book in the legendary fantasy series.

Casting the Resident Ghosts and Portraits

Leo Bill has been cast as Nearly Headless Nick, the friendly house ghost of Gryffindor. Andrew Brooke will portray the Bloody Baron, the spectral resident associated with Slytherin House.

Laura Smyth has been tapped to appear as the Fat Lady, the oil painting portrait guarding the entrance to Gryffindor Tower. Additionally, Daniel Fearn will play the Fat Friar, representing Hufflepuff House.

Bringing the Sorting Hat to Life

Completing this specific round of casting announcements, David Threlfall has been chosen to provide the voice of the iconic Sorting Hat. The magical artifact is responsible for placing every incoming first-year student into their respective house.

These new additions ensure that the atmospheric details and beloved supporting fixtures of the wizarding world will feature prominently in the new production.

Core Trio and Distinguished Faculty

The newly announced performers join an already extensive ensemble for Harry Potter and the Philosopher’s Stone. The core trio features Dominic McLaughlin as Harry Potter, Arabella Stanton as Hermione Granger, and Alastair Stout as Ron Weasley.

They are supported by a veteran faculty lineup including John Lithgow as Albus Dumbledore, Janet McTeer as Minerva McGonagall, Paapa Essiedu as Severus Snape, and Nick Frost as Rubeus Hagrid.

Wider Ensemble and Creative Team

The broader cast includes Warwick Davis returning as Filius Flitwick, alongside Katherine Parkinson, Johnny Flynn, Bertie Carvel, Luke Thallon, Daniel Rigby, Bel Powley, and Paul Whitehouse.

Creative responsibilities are led by writer and executive producer Francesca Gardiner, with Mark Mylod directing multiple episodes and serving alongside executive producers including J.K. Rowling and David Heyman.

Release Details and Future Seasons

Production is already looking ahead to subsequent chapters, with a Season 2 cast taking shape to include Kit Harington as Gilderoy Lockhart and Lenny Rush as Dobby.

The first season of HBO's Harry Potter and the Philosopher’s Stone is scheduled to premiere on December 25, 2026, with streaming availability on HBO Max.

ld.articleBody:
Historic Third Week Milestone

Jailer 2 has officially etched its name in the record books by securing the biggest third week for any Kollywood film at the Indian box office. The action-comedy thriller pulled off an impressive performance during its third seven-day stretch, accumulating a notable sum of 37.4 crore net.

This stellar figure allowed the Rajinikanth-led feature to outperform its own predecessor, Jailer, which previously held the top spot with a third-week collection of 29.7 crore. Furthermore, this achievement makes Jailer 2 the first Tamil motion picture to cross the 30 crore net threshold during its third week in theaters.

Day 22 Collections And The Impact Of New Releases

On its fourth Thursday, which marked day 22 of its theatrical journey, the sequel brought in 1.6 crore net. This represented a substantial decrease of 52.24% compared to the previous day, when the film earned 3 crore net.

The sharp decline in daily earnings was primarily driven by the arrival of a major new competitor. The grand theatrical release of the epic magnum opus Ramayana on November 5 resulted in a severe reduction of screen allocations and show counts for the Rajinikanth starrer across various cinema halls.

Overall Box Office Totals In India

When examining the cumulative earnings up to its twenty-second day, Jailer 2 has amassed a massive total of 467.3 crore net at the domestic box office. When converted to gross figures, this incredible run amounts to approximately 551.43 crore.

The film's journey to these staggering numbers has been marked by strong weekly performances. It opened with a stellar 334.35 crore during its initial eight-day week, followed by a powerful second week grossing 95.55 crore before cooling down to 37.4 crore in its third week.

Comparison With Other Kollywood Blockbusters

The exceptional third-week performance of Jailer 2 places it at the absolute pinnacle of Tamil cinema box office history for that specific timeframe. It comfortably leads a competitive list of high-grossing Tamil titles.

Behind Jailer 2 and its predecessor Jailer in the third-week rankings are other notable hits. Vikram secured the third position with 27.15 crore, Amaran followed closely at fourth with 25.95 crore, and Ponniyin Selvan 1 rounded out the top tier with 23.5 crore.

Cast, Crew, And Release Background

Directed by Nelson Dilipkumar, the Tamil action-comedy thriller is backed by producer Kalanithi Maran under the banner of Sun Pictures. The project features a massive ensemble cast alongside the lead actor.

Alongside Rajinikanth, the film showcases performances from SJ Suryah, Mithun Chakraborty, Suraj Venjaramoodu, Ramya Krishnan, and Vidya Balan in pivotal roles. The movie officially arrived in cinemas on October 15, 2026.

Upcoming Theatrical Challenges

The historic box office run of the action sequel faces additional hurdles moving forward beyond its twenty-second day. The reduction in momentum is expected to continue as fresh cinematic offerings capture audience attention.

Alongside the ongoing dominance of Ramayana, the theatrical exhibition of Jailer 2 is set to face further impact from the release of Suriya's film Scene, which promises to tighten competition at the box office even further.

ld.articleBody:
Guest Appearance on Double Date

Actor and singer Shruti Haasan along with music composer Vishal Dadlani recently appeared as guests on the talk show Double Date with Neha Dhupia and Angad Bedi. As hosts Neha and Angad picked up their guests from home, the group engaged in a lively conversation about their musical preferences while heading to the studio for the shoot.

The casual commute quickly turned into an entertaining exchange about various music genres, with the passengers sharing their appreciation for different artists and iconic tracks from the entertainment industry.

Praise for Daler Mehndi

The musical discussion began when Shruti expressed her immense admiration for legendary Punjabi singer Daler Mehndi. She declared herself to be one of his biggest fans on the planet, specifically highlighting his global hit Tunak Tunak Tun as her absolute favourite track.

Weighing in on the artist's global reach, Vishal agreed that the track remains one of India's most significant cultural exports. He even described the iconic song as timeless and of a scale that surpasses many contemporary artists.

Discussion on Diljit Dosanjh and Case

Shifting the conversation to the current generation of Punjabi musicians, Shruti noted that she enjoys a wide spectrum of Punjabi music ranging from classy to casual styles. When asked to name her favorite from the current lot, she immediately named Diljit Dosanjh and mentioned his song Case.

Since the composer was unfamiliar with the specific track, fellow guest Angad Bedi sang a few lines of the song to jog his memory, explaining the lyrical essence of an ongoing court or police case.

Vishal Dadlani's Humorous Reaction

Upon hearing the lyrical theme of Diljit's song, Vishal made the entire car burst into laughter by quipping that the subject matter felt entirely too familiar to his own life experiences. He humorously insisted that he had personally felt the weight of those particular lyrics.

The lighthearted joke drew chuckles from the hosts and Shruti alike, turning a simple discussion about modern Punjabi music into a self-deprecating moment regarding the composer's past.

A Look Back at Past Legal Troubles

The composer's playful comment referenced real legal hurdles he faced in the past. In 2016, an FIR was filed against Vishal and activist Tehseen Poonawalla over a social media post concerning a speech given at the Haryana State Legislative Assembly by a Digambar Jain monk.

Though the Punjab and Haryana High Court quashed the criminal proceedings in 2019 while imposing a fine, the matter eventually reached the Supreme Court. By 2025, the apex court set aside the previous order with the observation that judicial forums should not be used for moral policing.

Recent Projects of the Stars

Aside from his appearance on the talk show, Vishal recently handled the full album composition for the theatrical release Tu Meri Main Tera Main Tera Tu Meri, starring Kartik Aaryan and Ananya Panday.

Vishal Dadlani Jokes About Legal Troubles After Shruti Haasan Mentions Diljit Dosanjh Song On Talk Show

During a car ride on Double Date with Neha Dhupia and Angad Bedi, actor Shruti Haasan and composer Vishal Dadlani discussed Punjabi music, leading to a humorous quip from Vishal.

Published 14 November 2026

Guest Appearance on Double Date

Actor and singer Shruti Haasan along with music composer Vishal Dadlani recently appeared as guests on the talk show Double Date with Neha Dhupia and Angad Bedi. As hosts Neha and Angad picked up their guests from home, the group engaged in a lively conversation about their musical preferences while heading to the studio for the shoot.

The casual commute quickly turned into an entertaining exchange about various music genres, with the passengers sharing their appreciation for different artists and iconic tracks from the entertainment industry.

Praise for Daler Mehndi

The musical discussion began when Shruti expressed her immense admiration for legendary Punjabi singer Daler Mehndi. She declared herself to be one of his biggest fans on the planet, specifically highlighting his global hit Tunak Tunak Tun as her absolute favourite track.

Weighing in on the artist's global reach, Vishal agreed that the track remains one of India's most significant cultural exports. He even described the iconic song as timeless and of a scale that surpasses many contemporary artists.

Discussion on Diljit Dosanjh and Case

Shifting the conversation to the current generation of Punjabi musicians, Shruti noted that she enjoys a wide spectrum of Punjabi music ranging from classy to casual styles. When asked to name her favorite from the current lot, she immediately named Diljit Dosanjh and mentioned his song Case.

Since the composer was unfamiliar with the specific track, fellow guest Angad Bedi sang a few lines of the song to jog his memory, explaining the lyrical essence of an ongoing court or police case.

Vishal Dadlani's Humorous Reaction

Upon hearing the lyrical theme of Diljit's song, Vishal made the entire car burst into laughter by quipping that the subject matter felt entirely too familiar to his own life experiences. He humorously insisted that he had personally felt the weight of those particular lyrics.

The lighthearted joke drew chuckles from the hosts and Shruti alike, turning a simple discussion about modern Punjabi music into a self-deprecating moment regarding the composer's past.

A Look Back at Past Legal Troubles

The composer's playful comment referenced real legal hurdles he faced in the past. In 2016, an FIR was filed against Vishal and activist Tehseen Poonawalla over a social media post concerning a speech given at the Haryana State Legislative Assembly by a Digambar Jain monk.

Though the Punjab and Haryana High Court quashed the criminal proceedings in 2019 while imposing a fine, the matter eventually reached the Supreme Court. By 2025, the apex court set aside the previous order with the observation that judicial forums should not be used for moral policing.

Recent Projects of the Stars

Aside from his appearance on the talk show, Vishal recently handled the full album composition for the theatrical release Tu Meri Main Tera Main Tera Tu Meri, starring Kartik Aaryan and Ananya Panday.

Shruti has likewise kept busy with major cinematic projects. Following her appearance in Lokesh Kanagaraj's Coolie, she is slated to star in the Tamil film Train as well as the Telugu movie Aakasamlo Oka Tara.

After marking one year of sobriety, he accepts a dangerous assignment to transport a rare human liver. The organ is urgently needed for Ellie, a 7-year-old girl played by Scarlett Crabtree, who possesses the rare golden blood type and faces a serious illness.

Lilith reluctantly returns to her chaotic home planet of Pandora. Once there, she is hired by the powerful corporate arms dealer Atlas, played by Édgar Ramírez, to track down his missing daughter, Tiny Tina, brought to life by Ariana Greenblatt.

ld.articleBody:
Production Starts on Patricia

Netflix has officially boarded the upcoming domestic violence drama titled Patricia, confirming that filming is now getting underway. The project is written and directed by Juan Diego Botto, bringing together a notable creative team to explore a serious and sensitive topic.

Penélope Cruz takes on the title role of Patricia, bringing her extensive acting experience to a character dealing with harrowing personal struggles. This feature also serves as a major milestone for Cruz behind the scenes as a producer.

Moonlyon's First Narrative Feature

The film marks the very first narrative feature produced under Moonlyon, the audiovisual company founded by Penélope Cruz. Moonlyon launched in 2022 as part of the Barcelona-based sports and entertainment group Imagina, which was previously known as Grup Mediapro before a September rebranding.

Developing the project has been a lengthy endeavor for the star and her production banner. Cruz spent over two years bringing the feature to this production stage, working closely alongside Botto through the scriptwriting and preparation phases.

Plot and Character Details

In Patricia, the central character manages to escape a nightmarish twelve-year abusive relationship. However, her fight for safety and stability is far from over once she enters the court system.

Facing a new kind of legal hell, Patricia lives in constant fear regarding the safety and wellbeing of her children. The narrative aims to shine a light on the daily suffering experienced by many women facing similar forms of domestic abuse.

Supporting Cast and Creative Collaborations

Alongside Penélope Cruz in the lead role, the movie features a talented ensemble cast. Confirmed cast members include Goya Toledo, Ramón Barea, and Dylan Radley.

The film reunites Cruz and Juan Diego Botto following their previous work together on Botto's 2022 directorial debut, the social thriller On The Fringe. Botto's broader career includes close to eighty feature acting credits, such as The Suicide Squad, The Room Next Door, and Breaking Falls.

Director's Research and Approach

Director Juan Diego Botto approached the sensitive subject matter with extensive preparation. His creative process involved a long research phase featuring hours of interviews with real women who shared their stories with the filmmakers.

Botto's feature directorial debut, On The Fringe, previously premiered in the Horizons sidebar of the Venice Film Festival in 2022. He has expressed deep gratitude for the opportunity to bring this specific narrative to the screen with such a dedicated cast and crew.

Netflix Partnership and Investment

Netflix boarded the project after reviewing the script, marking Penélope Cruz's first time working with the platform. Diego Ávalos, Netflix's vice president of originals for Spain, Portugal, Turkey, and the Middle East, praised the film as a courageous and unforgettable story.

The acquisition aligns with Netflix's substantial commitment to Spanish productions. The streamer established its biggest European production hub for non-English-language content in Spain in 2015, pledging more than €1 billion in investments between 2025 and 2028 to celebrate its tenth anniversary in the country.

ld.articleBody:
Second Sunday Surge

The epic saga witnessed a remarkable growth spurt on its second Sunday, collecting Rs 75 crore across 23,525 shows on November 15, 2026. This figure marked a notable 33.6 percent increase compared to the previous Sunday's earnings of Rs 56.15 crore.

Makers expanded show allocations across multiple regional languages to accommodate the surging demand, reflecting strong audience turnout during the film's second week in theatres.

Language-Wise Breakdown

The domestic performance was anchored by robust numbers from the Hindi version, which contributed Rs 55 crore to the day's tally.

Regional versions also added steady sums, with the Kannada version bringing in Rs 5.75 crore, Malayalam generating Rs 5 crore, Tamil earning Rs 4.75 crore, and the Telugu version rounding it out with Rs 4.50 crore.

Cumulative Domestic and Global Totals

Following these figures, the total India nett collections for the production crossed the Rs 760.60 crore mark, successfully pushing past the Rs 750 crore milestone in its second week.

On the global front, the movie accumulated a massive gross collection of Rs 1,384.50 crore, establishing a commanding presence worldwide with IMAX screenings enhancing its cinematic reach.

Cast and Production Background

Helmed by director Nitesh Tiwari and produced by Namit Malhotra through Prime Focus Studios alongside Yash's Monster Mind Creations, the ambitious project features a star-studded cast.

Ranbir Kapoor portrays Lord Rama, Yash steps into the role of Ravana, Sai Pallavi plays Sita, and Ravie Dubey appears as Lakshman in the multi-part cinematic undertaking.

International Milestones

Beyond domestic success, the film achieved a historic feat in North America by earning $24.1 million over 11 days, overtaking previous contenders to become the top Indian film of all time in the US and Canada.

Its international rollout has already touched markets such as the UK, North America, Hong Kong, Thailand, Indonesia, and Australia, with further expansions slated across Europe and Latin America.

Future Global Expansion Plans

The release schedule continues throughout November 2026, reaching territories like Brazil, Italy, Ukraine, Hungary, Poland, Argentina, and Colombia.

Furthermore, producers have scheduled major theatrical launches in four prominent international markets—China, Japan, South Korea, and Russia—during the first quarter of 2027.

Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana Part 1 crossed Rs 760.60 crore in India after earning Rs 75 crore on its second Sunday, November 15, 2026. The film also set a new milestone in North America while eyeing further global expansions.

Ramayana Box Office Collection Day 11: Ranbir Kapoor and Yash Starrer Surpasses Rs 750 Crore in India

Nitesh Tiwari's directorial venture crosses major domestic and international milestones on its second Sunday.

Published 16 November 2026

Second Sunday Surge

The epic saga witnessed a remarkable growth spurt on its second Sunday, collecting Rs 75 crore across 23,525 shows on November 15, 2026. This figure marked a notable 33.6 percent increase compared to the previous Sunday's earnings of Rs 56.15 crore.

Makers expanded show allocations across multiple regional languages to accommodate the surging demand, reflecting strong audience turnout during the film's second week in theatres.

Language-Wise Breakdown

The domestic performance was anchored by robust numbers from the Hindi version, which contributed Rs 55 crore to the day's tally.

Regional versions also added steady sums, with the Kannada version bringing in Rs 5.75 crore, Malayalam generating Rs 5 crore, Tamil earning Rs 4.75 crore, and the Telugu version rounding it out with Rs 4.50 crore.

Cumulative Domestic and Global Totals

Following these figures, the total India nett collections for the production crossed the Rs 760.60 crore mark, successfully pushing past the Rs 750 crore milestone in its second week.

On the global front, the movie accumulated a massive gross collection of Rs 1,384.50 crore, establishing a commanding presence worldwide with IMAX screenings enhancing its cinematic reach.

Cast and Production Background

Helmed by director Nitesh Tiwari and produced by Namit Malhotra through Prime Focus Studios alongside Yash's Monster Mind Creations, the ambitious project features a star-studded cast.

Ranbir Kapoor portrays Lord Rama, Yash steps into the role of Ravana, Sai Pallavi plays Sita, and Ravie Dubey appears as Lakshman in the multi-part cinematic undertaking.

International Milestones

Beyond domestic success, the film achieved a historic feat in North America by earning $24.1 million over 11 days, overtaking previous contenders to become the top Indian film of all time in the US and Canada.

Its international rollout has already touched markets such as the UK, North America, Hong Kong, Thailand, Indonesia, and Australia, with further expansions slated across Europe and Latin America.

Future Global Expansion Plans

The release schedule continues throughout November 2026, reaching territories like Brazil, Italy, Ukraine, Hungary, Poland, Argentina, and Colombia.

Furthermore, producers have scheduled major theatrical launches in four prominent international markets—China, Japan, South Korea, and Russia—during the first quarter of 2027.

News Overview

Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana Part 1 crossed Rs 760.60 crore in India after earning Rs 75 crore on its second Sunday, November 15, 2026. The film also set a new milestone in North America while eyeing further global expansions.

Key facts

  • Ramayana earned Rs 75 crore on November 15, 2026.
  • The total India nett collections reached Rs 760.60 crore.
  • Global gross collections touched Rs 1,384.50 crore.
  • The film earned $24.1 million in 11 days in North America.

ld.articleBody:
A Landmark BBC Comedy

The BBC has long been celebrated for producing exceptional television, ranging from gritty dramas to timeless sitcoms. Alongside classic comedies like Fawlty Towers, Only Fools and Horses, Blackadder, Yes, Minister, and Ricky Gervais' The Office, recent hits such as Fleabag have showcased Britain's top comedic talents.

Among these celebrated titles, one 34-episode BBC sitcom has carved out a unique legacy. Its hilarious and heartwarming premise proved so universally appealing that it quickly captured the attention of international networks looking to bring the concept to local audiences.

The Premise of Ghosts

Premiering in 2019, Ghosts follows estate inheritors Alison and Mike as they attempt to convert a crumbling mansion into a luxurious hotel. Their plans take an extraordinary turn when a near-death experience grants Alison the ability to see the diverse group of spirits haunting the property.

The ghostly residents span multiple eras of history, including a caveman, a Georgian noblewoman, a Regency poet, a World War II officer, and a 1980s scout leader. Created by the same troupe behind Horrible Histories, the show blends sharp wit with historical elements.

Balancing Humor and Heart

Ghosts successfully bridges the gap between family-friendly viewing and clever adult humor. The series features running gags about the afterlife, political corruption, and murder, balanced with slapstick comedy and touching character moments.

Rather than relying on overly complex worldbuilding, the series keeps its mythology simple. This allows the evolving relationships between the living couple and the spectral roommates to remain the emotional core of the narrative.

Global Adaptations and Remakes

The core concept of Ghosts proved easily adaptable across different cultures and histories, unlike some British comedies that struggled in translation. This universal appeal led to six separate international remakes.

Networks in the US, Australia, Germany, France, Greece, and Czechia all developed their own versions of the show, proving that the blend of supernatural fantasy and domestic sitcom works on a global scale.

Cultural Impact and Legacy

Even three years after its final television season wrapped up, Ghosts remains a powerhouse in British pop culture. The American adaptation has also achieved massive success, surpassing the original series in episode count.

The show's ability to maintain high quality across its five-season run solidified its status as a modern classic, influencing how supernatural sitcoms are structured and produced today.

The Feature Film Continuation

Demonstrating its lasting popularity, the entire cast reunited for a theatrical feature film titled Ghosts: The Possession of Button House. Set months after the series finale, the story follows the ghosts as they interact with teenage trespassers.

Transitioning a sitcom into a feature film is a rare achievement, placing Ghosts alongside select titles like The Simpsons Movie, The Inbetweeners Movie, and Sex and the City.

News Overview

A 34-episode BBC sitcom titled Ghosts has achieved widespread international acclaim and inspired six different remakes across the US, Australia, Germany, France, Greece, and Czechia. The acclaimed comedy series also transitioned to the big screen with a feature film sequel following its television run.

ld.articleBody:
Moushumi Chatterjee Confirms Husband's Passing

Veteran film actress Moushumi Chatterjee recently shared the heartbreaking news of the death of her husband, Jayanta Mukherjee, via social media. Affectionately known as Babu by friends and loved ones, Jayanta passed away after battling age-related ailments at their home in Mumbai.

In her heartfelt online message, Moushumi expressed deep gratitude to well-wishers for their ongoing support and prayers. At the same time, she earnestly appealed to the public and media to grant her and her daughter the necessary time and space to navigate this extremely difficult period of personal grief.

Details Of Passing And Prayer Meet

According to official confirmations, Jayanta Mukherjee breathed his last on November 12, 2026. BN Tiwari, the president of the Federation of Western India Cine Employees, verified the news to media agencies, noting that the producer had been dealing with health complications for quite some time.

Following his demise, the family organized a prayer meeting to honor his memory. His daughter, Megha, issued a formal statement announcing that the gathering would take place on November 15, 2026, at Shri Khatwari Darbar located in Khar West, Mumbai, scheduled for the evening.

Legacy In The Entertainment Industry

Jayanta Mukherjee came from a rich artistic lineage as the son of the legendary singer and composer Hemant Kumar. Rather than relying solely on his father's immense musical legacy, Jayanta carved out his own distinct career path within the Indian entertainment sector.

He established himself as a notable film and television producer over the decades, contributing behind the scenes to various cinematic and television projects that captured the attention of audiences during their respective broadcast and theatrical runs.

Notable Production Credits

Throughout his career in the industry, Jayanta was associated with several notable movie titles. Among his film credits are projects like the 1975 film 'Mazaaq' and the 1979 feature 'Do Ladke Dono Kadke'.

In addition to his work in feature films, he also ventured into television production. His small-screen credits notably include working on the television serial 'Talaash', which aired in 1992.

Industry Reactions And Support

The entertainment community responded with sorrow upon learning of Jayanta Mukherjee's passing. Colleagues, film industry representatives, and fans expressed their condolences to Moushumi Chatterjee and her family via social media and personal messages.

The Federation of Western India Cine Employees also acknowledged his contributions to the film fraternity, standing in solidarity with the grieving family as they prepared to bid their final farewells during the scheduled prayer meet.

Family And Personal Life

Moushumi Chatterjee and Jayanta Mukherjee shared a long-standing marriage that weathered decades in the public eye. Their daughter, Megha, has been actively involved in managing the family's official communications during this tragic time.

The family has maintained a dignified approach to their loss, balancing public acknowledgments of support with strict requests for personal privacy as they mourn the loss of a husband and father.

The family requested privacy while announcing a prayer meeting for November 15, 2026, honoring his life and his work in films like 'Mazaaq', 'Do Ladke Dono Kadke', and television's 'Talaash'.

ld.articleBody:
Doctor Doom Takes Center Stage

Marvel Studios and the directing duo Anthony and Joe Russo have generated considerable excitement by releasing a fresh wave of promotional material for the upcoming blockbuster Avengers: Doomsday. The studio published a set of seven distinct artworks that focus entirely on the central antagonist, Doctor Doom.

Portrayed by Robert Downey Jr., the character dominates every frame of the new promotional campaign. The artwork emphasizes a menacing and mysterious visual style designed to establish the villain as a formidable threat in the forthcoming cinematic event.

Showcasing Premium Theatrical Formats

Alongside the striking imagery of the villain, the promotional rollout serves to spotlight the various high-end theatrical screening formats that will be available to audiences upon release.

Fans planning to experience the massive ensemble movie in theaters can choose from an array of specialized formats, including Infinity Vision, RealD 3D, HDR by Barco, Dolby Cinema, ScreenX, and 4DX.

A Breakdown of the Promotional Artworks

The seven newly revealed posters offer varied glimpses into the aesthetic and tone surrounding the antagonist. The first artwork portrays the character standing before stained glass, wearing a green cloak and metallic mask that give him a distinctly royal aura.

Subsequent posters feature close-up shots of the metallic mask illuminated by emerald lighting, atmospheric green fog surrounding the figure, and the villain inspecting glowing green energy. Additional designs showcase hooded figures in diverse outfits, a dramatic pose with a flowing green cloak, and a final image of the character seated regally on an immense throne.

Behind the Scenes and Release Details

The promotional images were shared via Instagram by directors Anthony and Joe Russo, giving eager fans another deep dive into the look of the film prior to its premiere.

Avengers: Doomsday is scheduled to arrive in cinemas on December 18, 2026. The high-profile Marvel project is being steered by the Russo brothers and is set to feature a massive ensemble cast.

ld.articleBody:
Third Weekend Milestone

Rajinikanth's action-drama sequel Jailer 2 has crossed another significant commercial milestone during its third weekend in cinemas. The film, which arrived on the big screen on October 15, has maintained its theatrical momentum across multiple languages.

Following a growth spurt on Saturday, the movie registered another collection increase on Sunday, pushing its worldwide gross revenue past the Rs 800 crore threshold.

Domestic Earnings and Weekend Totals

Based on estimates from Sacnilk, Jailer 2 brought in Rs 11.20 crore net across all domestic languages on Day 18, which was Sunday, November 1. This figure represented a 15.5 percent increase compared to Saturday's estimated earnings of Rs 9.70 crore.

The Sunday addition brought the cumulative domestic net collection to Rs 456.30 crore, while the India gross stands at Rs 533.75 crore. Earlier in the weekend, the movie earned Rs 5.50 crore net on its third Friday before climbing over the weekend to deliver a third-weekend total of Rs 26.40 crore.

Overseas and Global Accumulation

In addition to its domestic success, the film continued to pull numbers from international territories on Day 18. Reports indicate the feature added Rs 3 crore gross from overseas markets.

This international performance pushed the cumulative overseas gross collection to Rs 273.50 crore. When combined with the domestic figures, the Rajinikanth vehicle reached an estimated worldwide gross of Rs 807.25 crore in 18 days.

Language-Wise Performance Breakdown

Jailer 2 continued its theatrical run across Tamil, Hindi, Telugu, and Kannada versions on Sunday. The Tamil version led the domestic collections with Rs 8 crore.

Meanwhile, the Hindi version contributed Rs 1.75 crore, the Telugu version brought in Rs 1 crore, and the Kannada version added Rs 45 lakh to round out the Rs 11.20 crore total.

Occupancy Rates and Screen Counts

The Tamil version generated the highest occupancy among all language variants, recording an estimated 34.3 percent across 4,287 shows. The Kannada version followed with 31 percent occupancy across 250 shows.

The Telugu version saw 28.3 percent occupancy across 777 shows, while the Hindi version registered roughly 15 percent occupancy from 3,592 shows, resulting in a total of 8,906 screenings across India on Day 18.

Cast, Crew and Creative Background

Written and directed by Nelson Dilipkumar, Jailer 2 serves as the continuation of the 2023 hit Jailer. Rajinikanth stars once again as retired jailer Muthuvel Pandian, supported by returning actors Ramya Krishnan, Yogi Babu, Mirnaa, and Rithvik.

The expanded cast also welcomes S. J. Suryah, Mithun Chakraborty, Suraj Venjaramoodu, and Vidya Balan, alongside cameo appearances by Mohanlal, Shiva Rajkumar, Vijay Sethupathi, Jackie Shroff, and Hrithik Roshan. The film is produced by Kalanithi Maran under Sun Pictures with music by Anirudh Ravichander.

News Overview

Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 surpassed Rs 800 crore worldwide by its eighteenth day in theatres, driven by strong domestic and overseas earnings. The Nelson Dilipkumar directorial recorded a cumulative domestic net of Rs 456.30 crore alongside strong multi-language theatrical occupancies.

Following a growth spurt on Saturday, the movie registered another collection increase on Sunday, pushing its worldwide gross revenue past the Rs 800 crore threshold.

Domestic Earnings and Weekend Totals

Based on estimates from Sacnilk, Jailer 2 brought in Rs 11.20 crore net across all domestic languages on Day 18, which was Sunday, November 1. This figure represented a 15.5 percent increase compared to Saturday's estimated earnings of Rs 9.70 crore.

Jailer 2 continued its theatrical run across Tamil, Hindi, Telugu, and Kannada versions on Sunday. The Tamil version led the domestic collections with Rs 8 crore.

Suryah, Mithun Chakraborty, Suraj Venjaramoodu, and Vidya Balan, alongside cameo appearances by Mohanlal, Shiva Rajkumar, Vijay Sethupathi, Jackie Shroff, and Hrithik Roshan. ld.articleBody:
The Global Television Celebration

The 54th International Emmy Awards took place at the New York Hilton Midtown, bringing together television professionals and international stars from around the world. Actor Michael Urie, recognized for his work in Ugly Betty and Shrinking, took on the role of host for the star-studded evening.

The prestigious global event was designed to recognize and honor outstanding television programs and performances spanning across sixteen categories from twenty-two different countries.

Vijay Sethupathi's Red Carpet Look

Indian actor Vijay Sethupathi was officially announced as one of the presenters for the global television ceremony, making him the lone Indian personality taking the stage as a presenter this year.

He captured attention on the red carpet with a distinctive and formal fashion choice. The actor wore a black tailored suit that featured intricate statement gold embroidery, creating a dramatic appearance for the international gathering.

Connections and Past Indian Presenters

Producer Kavita Gupta, who also serves as a board member of the International Academy of Television Arts and Sciences, played a vital role in facilitating the Maharaja star's participation at the event. She previously assisted comedian Vir Das in hosting the ceremony in 2024.

Vijay Sethupathi joins a select group of Indian personalities who have previously presented at the International Emmys. Past presenters include Aashka Goradia in 2009, Simone Singh in 2010, and Prerna Wanvari, who presented an award in the Arts Programming category in 2012.

Indian Nominations at the Ceremony

India secured multiple notable nominations at this year's international awards event. Comedian Vir Das earned a nomination in the Comedy category for his Netflix special titled Vir Das: Fool Volume, marking his third nomination following previous nods for For India in 2021 and Landing in 2023.

Additionally, India received a second nomination in the Drama Series category for Real Kashmir Football Club. The SonyLIV production features performances by actors Manav Kaul and Mohammed Zeeshan Ayyub.

International Presenter Lineup

Alongside the Indian actor, the global roster of presenters featured a wide array of international talent from film and television.

The diverse group included Lauren Chan, Sophie Charlotte, David Ajala, Max von der Groeben, José Díaz-Balart, Celia Imrie, James Monroe Iglehart, Gus Kenworthy, Ulah Pate, Jay Pharoah, Rita Pereira, Andrea Riseborough, Keri Russell, Andrea Savage, Mark Tallman, David Zaslav, Constance Zimmer, and Robbie G.K.

Upcoming Projects for the Star

Following his recent cameo appearance in Jailer 2, the actor has several upcoming film releases scheduled in the near future. He stars in the upcoming action thriller Train, directed by Mysskin and produced by Kalaipuli S Thanu under V Creations, which also features Nassar, Shruti Haasan, Ira Dayanand, Preethy Karan, and Narain Ram.

Additionally, he is part of the film Inji Vellam, directed by Mani Ratnam and starring Sai Pallavi alongside Chaithra J Achar.

Indian actor Vijay Sethupathi attended the 54th International Emmy Awards in New York as a presenter, wearing a black tailored suit with gold embroidery. The ceremony celebrated international television across multiple categories and featured nominations for Indian projects including Vir Das: Fool Volume and Real Kashmir Football Club.

ld.articleBody:
The Grand Entrance at Kyocera Dome Osaka

The second night of the music ceremony brought immense excitement as major K-pop acts gathered in Japan. Taking place at Kyocera Dome Osaka, the evening featured high-profile performances and striking visual presentations that immediately caught the attention of fans worldwide.

Among all the attendees, BIGBANG member G-Dragon became the central focus of the evening. His daring aesthetic choice instantly shifted the energy in the venue, setting a dramatic tone for the group's highly anticipated appearance.

A Dramatic and Colorful Hairstyle Shift

Stepping onto the venue grounds, the singer unveiled waist-length, pin-straight locks infused with a vibrant combination of black, hot pink, and red hues. This radical aesthetic served as a massive departure from the shorter and bleached hairstyles that have defined much of his historic career.

The bold look immediately triggered widespread online chatter. Observers drew immediate parallels between his flowing tresses and the signature styles of South Korea's most celebrated rock icons.

Theatrical Resurrection Theme on Stage

The striking hair choice served as a visual anchor for BIGBANG's elaborate stage production. G-Dragon, alongside bandmates Taeyang and Daesung, delivered a powerful set that began with an unforgettable entrance.

Emerging through a coffin-shaped prop adorned with the Latin inscription 'VENI VIDI VICI'—meaning 'I came, I saw, I conquered'—the star broke through the structure amidst swirling smoke. This resurrection-inspired display highlighted his new hair and electrified the arena.

Live Debut of Surprise Single 'GiiiRIP'

Beyond the visual spectacle, the legendary group used the platform to deliver powerful musical moments. They treated the audience to the first-ever live performance of their surprise single titled 'GiiiRIP'.

The track dropped shortly before the ceremony, adding extra momentum to their appearance. The performance demonstrated that the group remains at the top of their game creatively.

A Humorous Mic-Moment During Acceptance

The extravagant length of the hair also led to a delightfully comical episode on stage. While accepting the award for Music Visionary of the Year, the frontman struggled as his strands repeatedly fell across his face while speaking into the microphone.

In a display of camaraderie, Daesung quickly stepped in to hold the hair out of the way with both hands, soon joined by Taeyang. The heartwarming and playful interaction left the audience laughing and cheering.

Comparisons to Legendary Rock Musicians

Following the broadcast, viewers and commentators flooded social media platforms with discussions about his appearance. Many noted that the aesthetic echoed the late Shin Hae Chul, fondly remembered as the 'Demon King' of Korean rock.

Others pointed out similarities to veteran rock vocalists Park Wan Kyu and Kim Kyung Ho, both famous for their long manes. Fans praised his ability to continuously reinvent his image without losing his unique artistic edge.

Anniversary Triumphs and Ongoing Global Tour

Marking their 20th anniversary since debut, the group secured three major honors at the event. Aside from Music Visionary of the Year, they won Fans' Choice Male Top 10 and Best Music Video with YouTube for their release 'BiiiG'.

Currently, the members are actively meeting international supporters through their 'XX : COSMOS' concert tour while continuing active promotions for their latest musical output.

News Overview

G-Dragon drew widespread attention at the 2026 MAMA Awards in Osaka with a dramatic waist-length hairstyle featuring black, hot pink, and red tones. The look complemented BIGBANG's theatrical stage entrance and sparked comparisons to legendary Korean rock musicians, all while the group celebrated multiple wins and performed their new single during their 20th anniversary year.
